story: Stage 5 of the Vuelta a Andalucía Ruta Ciclista del Sol opened with a three-rider breakaway that included representation from UAE Team Emirates and Q36.5 Pro Cycling Team, building a maximum lead of 2.5 minutes. With the responsibility for the chase falling to Team Visma | Lease a Bike and Movistar Team, the gap was steadily reduced. The attackers were caught on the first ascent of the Alto de la Primera Cruz, after which the race remained aggressive with several late moves that ultimately failed to stick. On the final climb, Q36.5 increased the pace before launching Tom Pidcock, who attacked decisively and rode solo to the finish to seal the stage win.
